title: Training Sheet: Spend Thresholds, Part-Spending and Credit Counts across the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes
content:
Associates on the upgrade desk are asked three things about nearly every credit: how much the new piece must cost, whether the credit may be spent in parts, and how many credits a customer may hold or spend at once. The published figures for each of the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes are set out here.

## The figures

| Programme | Multiple of the credit the new piece must cost | Uplift over the original selling price the new piece must carry | New piece must be of the same or a higher grade | Credit may be spent in parts |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | 1.5 | 50 percent | no | no |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | 2.0 | 100 percent | yes | no |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | 2.0 | 100 percent | yes | yes |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | 2.0 | 100 percent | yes | yes |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | 1.5 | 50 percent | yes | yes |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | 0.0 | 0 percent | no | yes |

| Programme | Live credits one customer may hold at once | Credits that may be spent on one sale |
|---|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | 2 | 1 |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | 2 | 1 |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | 1 | 1 |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | 3 | 2 |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | 1 | 1 |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | 4 | 2 |

## Points of judgement

**What does a multiple of 2.0 mean?** That the new piece must cost at least twice the credit. A multiple of 1.5 means one and a half times the credit. The Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme publishes a multiple of 0.0 and an uplift of 0 percent: it sets no such threshold.

**What does an uplift of 100 percent mean?** That the new piece must cost at least twice what the traded piece originally sold for; an uplift of 50 percent means at least one and a half times that price.

**Which programmes let a credit be spent across several purchases?** The Bridal Upgrade Guarantee, the Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee, the Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege and the Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme. Under the Belrose Standard Trade-In and the Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee the credit is spent once.

**Under which programmes may two credits go on one sale?** The Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee and the Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme, at 2 each. Every other programme allows 1.
